verdict.rationale: Khoj lets users self-host so data never leaves their device (khoj-docs-38, khoj-docs-3) and offers a telemetry opt-out via an environment variable (khoj-docs-21), giving some control over data handling. However, there is no documented feature for deleting stored indexed files/chat history or managing retention within Khoj Cloud, and a community comment notes the telemetry opt-out wasn't clearly documented (khoj-comm-9), raising doubts about ease of control on hosted use. Missing for 10: explicit data-deletion/account-deletion controls, retention policy documentation, and any first-party statement on how long data is kept in cloud/hosted mode.
